newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Kuok Philippine to sell Shangri-La shares.
newsitem.headline: Kuok Philippine to sell Shangri-La shares.

text.p: Kuok Philippine Properties Inc (KPPI) said on Thursday it will sell 25 million shares of Shangri-La Asia Limited at a price of HK $292.5 million to Robshar Limited, a wholly-owned unit of Kerry Holdings Limited.
KPPI, Kerry Holdings and Shangri-La Asia are part of the Kuok Group of Hong Kong.
Shangri-La Asia Limited is the holding company of the Shangri-La hotels chain.
KPPI said the price was HK $11.70 per share, the price at which the Shangri-La shares were transacted in the market on December 10.
KPPI said the sale of its shares to Robshar Limited will be done through Gipsey Limited, a company organised in British Virgin Islands which KPPI wholly owns.
